instructions.text: Weigh yourself every morning after using the bathroom and before breakfast. Write it down.
Keep salt (sodium) under 2,000 milligrams a day.
Limit all fluids to about 2 liters (8 cups) a day.
Do not take ibuprofen (Advil, Motrin) or naproxen (Aleve) unless your doctor says it is okay.
If you miss a dose, do not double up. Call the pharmacy for what to do.

warning_signs.sign: Weight up 3 pounds or more in one day, or 5 pounds or more in one week
More swelling in feet, ankles, legs, or belly
New or worse shortness of breath with activity, or needing more pillows to sleep
Dizzy or lightheaded when standing up
Breathing getting worse over a few hours, or a racing heartbeat that does not settle after 15 minutes of rest
warning_signs.action: Go to urgent care now or call the clinic's urgent line.

warning_signs.sign: Chest pain or pressure, severe trouble breathing at rest, fainting, sudden confusion, or coughing up pink foamy mucus
